chat.name: Chat
chat.description: Messages, commands, and the second chat.

commands.name: Commands
commands.description: Replies, typos, and the ignore list.

clickToReply.name: Click to reply (1.8)
clickToReply.description: Click the name in a private message to reply quickly.

preventCommandFailure.name: Block incorrect commands
preventCommandFailure.description: Block mistyped commands, for example 7p h or 7msg.

betterIgnoreList.name: Better ignore list (1.8)
betterIgnoreList.description: Show the ignore list across several easier-to-read lines.

display.name: Display
display.description: How names above players are shown.

showPrefixInDisplayName.name: Show colored prefix above players
showPrefixInDisplayName.description: Show the name above players in their prefix colors.

secondChat.name: Second chat
secondChat.description: A separate chat tab for selected messages.

chatTabName.name: Chat tab name
chatTabName.description: Name of the tab the addon uses for the second chat.

create.name: Create chat tab
create.description: Creates a chat tab using the name from 'Chat tab name'.

manageFilters.name: Manage filters
manageFilters.description: The addon manages the filters of the chat tab.

chatIndicators.name: Beta: Use chat indicators
chatIndicators.description: Show unread messages on the chat tab. Filters set on the tab then also apply to moved messages.

categories.name: Categories
categories.description: Which messages go to the second chat.

privateMessages.name: Private messages
privateMessages.description: Show private messages in the second chat.

sound.name: Private message sound
sound.description: Play a sound when you receive a private message.

patterns.name: Patterns
patterns.description: Regular expressions for private messages. The usual GrieferGames messages are filled in and can be edited. The list applies while the category is on. Invalid expressions are skipped and written to the log.

plotChat.name: Plot chat
plotChat.description: Show plot chat in the second chat.

patterns.name: Patterns
patterns.description: Regular expressions for plot messages. The usual GrieferGames messages are filled in and can be edited. The list applies while the category is on. Invalid expressions are skipped and written to the log.

remover.name: Remover
remover.description: Show item and mob remover messages in the second chat.

patterns.name: Patterns
patterns.description: Regular expressions for remover messages. The usual GrieferGames messages are filled in and can be edited. The list applies while the category is on. Invalid expressions are skipped and written to the log.

payments.name: Payments
payments.description: Show payments in the second chat.

patterns.name: Patterns
patterns.description: Regular expressions for payment messages. The usual GrieferGames messages are filled in and can be edited. The list applies while the category is on. Invalid expressions are skipped and written to the log.

bank.name: Bank
bank.description: Show bank messages in the second chat.

patterns.name: Patterns
patterns.description: Regular expressions for bank messages. The usual GrieferGames messages are filled in and can be edited. The list applies while the category is on. Invalid expressions are skipped and written to the log.

position.name: Show realname
position.description: Show /realname in the second chat, the main chat, or both.

mentions.name: Mentions
mentions.description: Highlight messages that contain your name.

mentionColor.name: Color
mentionColor.description: Background color used to highlight mentions.

mentionSound.name: Sound
mentionSound.description: Play a sound when somebody mentions your name in chat.

additionalHighlightText.name: Additional search text
additionalHighlightText.description: Extra text to search for in messages, for example 'Abge' in addition to the name AbgegrieftHD.

highlightTPA.name: Highlight TPA messages
highlightTPA.description: Mark TPA and TPAHERE messages in different colors.

hideVoteMessages.name: Hide vote messages
hideVoteMessages.description: Hide vote messages in the chat.

hideNewsMessages.name: Hide news
hideNewsMessages.description: Hide GrieferGames news in the chat.

hideBlankLines.name: Remove blank lines
hideBlankLines.description: Remove blank lines in the chat and block /clearchat.

hideSupremeBlankLines.name: Remove Supreme blank lines
hideSupremeBlankLines.description: Remove blank lines from Supreme players, for example ».

magic.name: Magic characters
magic.description: Replace unreadable clan tags and prefixes.

ampClantagEnabled.name: Replace magic clan tags
ampClantagEnabled.description: Replace magic characters in clan tags with readable text.

ampEnabled.name: Replace magic prefixes
ampEnabled.description: Make names with a magic prefix readable and mark them.

ampReplacement.name: New chat prefix
ampReplacement.description: Prefix used to mark names that had a magic prefix.

chatTime.name: Chat time
chatTime.description: Add the current time to chat messages.

chatTimeAfterMessage.name: After the message
chatTimeAfterMessage.description: Insert the time after the message.

chatTimeFormat.name: Format
chatTimeFormat.description: Format used for the chat time.

payment.name: Payments
payment.description: Log, highlight, and notifications for payments.

logTransactions.name: Log transactions
logTransactions.description: Save every transaction in a log file.

openTransactionsFile.name: Transaction log
openTransactionsFile.description: Open the transaction log in your text editor.

payAchievement.name: Notification
payAchievement.description: Show a notification for incoming payments.

payHighlight.name: Highlight payments
payHighlight.description: Mark verified payments in the chat.

fakeMoneyWarning.name: Warn about fake money
fakeMoneyWarning.description: Warn about fake payments that use a Supreme status.

bankAchievement.name: Bank notification
bankAchievement.description: Show a notification for bank transactions.

remover.name: Remover
remover.description: Timestamp and notification for the item and mob remover.

lastTimeHover.name: Timestamp
lastTimeHover.description: Show the timestamp when you hover a remover message.

notification.name: Notification
notification.description: Show the remover at the top right of the screen.

automations.name: Automations
automations.description: Portal, subserver message, and chat color.

sendSubServer.name: Subserver change message
sendSubServer.description: Sends a message when you change the subserver (for example a CityBuild or a Cloud region).

autoColor.name: Automatic chat color (1.8)
autoColor.description: Puts the color code in front of every message you send. This can interfere with commands from other addons or mods.

autoColorCloud.name: Automatic chat color (Cloud)
autoColorCloud.description: Puts the color in front of every message you send. This can interfere with commands from other addons or mods.

autoColorCloudColor.name: Chat color (Cloud)
autoColorCloudColor.description: Color your messages use on the Cloud.

colorGradientCloud.name: Chat color gradient (Cloud)
colorGradientCloud.description: Inserts a gradient between two hex colors, for example '##ff0000' and '##00ff00'.

afk.name: AFK
afk.description: Nickname and automatic reply while you are AFK.

afkTime.name: AFK after (minutes)
afkTime.description: Time after which the addon marks you as AFK.

afkNick.name: Set nickname
afkNick.description: Sets a nickname when you are marked AFK and removes it when you are back.

afkNickname.name: AFK nickname (4–16 characters)
afkNickname.description: Your nickname while you are AFK.

afkMsgReply.name: Reply to private messages
afkMsgReply.description: Automatically replies with a fixed text while you are AFK.

afkMsgText.name: Reply text
afkMsgText.description: Text of the automatic reply to private messages.

booster.name: Booster
booster.description: Load boosters on join and hide the menu (1.8).

loadBoostersOnJoin.name: Load on join
loadBoostersOnJoin.description: Loads boosters automatically when you join the server.

hideBoosterMenu.name: Hide menu
hideBoosterMenu.description: Blocks the /booster menu. The overview stays in chat.

friends.name: Friends
friends.description: Show others which CityBuild you are on.

showSubServerInLabyChat.name: Show CityBuild in LabyChat
showSubServerInLabyChat.description: Shows your friends in LabyChat which CityBuild you are on.

showSubServerInDiscord.name: Show CityBuild in Discord
showSubServerInDiscord.description: Shows your friends on Discord which CityBuild you are on.
